title.en: An Act Separating the Tukuran Technical-vocational High School – Baclay Extension in Barangay Baclay, Municipality of Tukuran, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur From the Tukuran Technical-vocational High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Baclay National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Baclay của Trường Trung học Kỹ thuật - Dạy nghề Tukuran tại Barangay Baclay, Đô thị Tukuran, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Sur khỏi Trường Trung học Kỹ thuật - Dạy nghề Tukuran và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Baclay Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Baclay ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเทคนิค-อาชีวศึกษา Tukuran ในบารังไกย์ Baclay เทศบาล Tukuran จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเทคนิค-อาชีวศึกษา Tukuran และยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Baclay แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Baclay, Sekolah Menengah Teknik-Kejuruan Tukuran di Barangay Baclay, Kotamadya Tukuran, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Sur dari Sekolah Menengah Teknik-Kejuruan Tukuran dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Baclay Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana

text.en: The Tukuran Technical-Vocationa High School - Baclay Extension in Barangay Baclay, Municipality of Tukuran, Province of Zamboanga del Sur is hereby separated from the Tukuran Technical-Vocational High School and converted it into an independent national high school to be known as the Baclay National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Tukuran Technical-Vocational High School - Baclay Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Baclay National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Baclay National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Tukuran Technical-Vocational High School - Baclay Extension. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

Within ninety (90) days from the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act. Such implementing rules and regulations shall provide for the school's organization, administration, operations and management, in accordance with Republic act No. 9155, or the "Governance of Basic Education Act of 2001," Republic Act No. 10533, or the "Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013," and other basic education-related laws.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
